subject: grimstroke_dark_portrait
description_zh: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。
description_en: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.

subject: snapfire_lil_shredder
description_zh: 电炎绝手开动蜥蜴坐骑上的加农炮，快速发动%buffed_attacks%次固定伤害加上自身攻击伤害一定百分比的攻击。每次攻击都将削弱敌人的护甲。在持续时间内提供攻击距离加成。
description_en: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire %buffed_attacks% attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
notes_zh: 持续时间内基础攻击间隔变为%base_attack_time%。
霹雳铁手的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。

subject: hoodwink_scurry
description_zh: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为%evasion_multiplier%倍。
description_en: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by %evasion_multiplier%.

subject: hoodwink_decoy
description_zh: 森海飞霞变为隐身，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。如果幻象被攻击或被指向性技能击中，幻象将被摧毁并且攻击者将受到较弱的野地奇袭效果。
description_en: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.

subject: hoodwink_sharpshooter
description_zh:
森海飞霞装载她的弩机，射出致命的一箭，对一名敌方英雄造成高额伤害，并施加破坏和减速效果。伤害和负面状态持续时间随着装载时间增加，%max_charge_time%秒后达到最大效果，弩箭在%misfire_time%秒后自动发射。
由于弩箭的威力，森海飞霞后退%recoil_distance%距离。弩箭穿过的非英雄单位会受到半额伤害。
description_en:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after %misfire_time% seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.

scepter.zh: 提升箭矢速度和减速效果。
scepter.en: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.

subject: dawnbreaker_fire_wreath
description_zh: 破晓辰星将她的战锤旋转3次，对敌人造成攻击伤害以及额外伤害。最后一次打击时，她将战锤击向地面，对她前方的敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
description_en: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
notes_zh: 破晓辰星在技能持续时间内以%movement_speed%的移动速度行进，并且最后一击后需要%self_stun_duration%秒才能复原。
连击期间无法施放上界重锤或天光现世。
此技能不继承分裂效果。
可以对自身施放来向前移动。
前两次挥击会减少敌人%swipe_slow%%%移动速度，持续%sweep_stun_duration%秒。

shard.zh: 破晓辰星在星破天惊期间获得减益免疫，%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性加成和自由移动状态。破晓辰星会被减速%shard_movement_penalty%%%，移速最低为%movement_speed%。
shard.en: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.

subject: dawnbreaker_solar_guardian
description_zh: 持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄%max_offset_distance%距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续%daytime_duration%秒的白天。每次脉冲都会对敌人造成伤害，并治疗友军。经过一段短暂时间后，她飞向目标地点，落地时造成额外伤害并眩晕敌人。开始持续施法后，破晓辰星无法中止此技能。
description_en: CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
notes_zh: 总飞行时间为%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法时间 + %airtime_duration%秒飞行时间。

scepter.zh: 天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随%scepter_aura_duration%秒。
scepter.en: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.

subject: marci_companion_run
description_zh:
玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对落地点的敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

回身踢设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，玛西会把她的友军目标带向最终目的地。

友军将获得%ally_movespeed_pct%%%移动速度加成，持续%ally_buff_duration%秒。
description_en:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
notes_zh: 玛西冲刺时目标单位可以躲避该效果。
多样施法时不会带走被缠绕或束缚的友军。

shard.zh: 提升伤害。回身踢可以对敌人施放，并且玛西施放后自身也会获得加速效果。
shard.en: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.

subject: marci_unleash
description_zh:
玛西释放潜藏的力量，获得狂怒的猛攻效果，使自身可以发动快速的打击，并且降低打击目标的移动和攻击速度，持续%pulse_debuff_duration%秒。每次狂怒连技的最后一击都会创造一个脉冲效果，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。在狂怒连技的间隔，玛西无法攻击，持续%time_between_flurries%秒。

玛西施放怒拳破时移动速度提升%bonus_movespeed%%%。
description_en:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
notes_zh: 每次狂怒连技开始后，每次攻击都必须在1秒内完成，否则连技将会终止。

scepter.zh: 怒拳破的冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction%秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续%pulse_silence_duration%秒。驱散类型：弱驱散
scepter.en: Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

subject: ringmaster_the_box
description_zh: 把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有相位移动状态，获得额外魔法抗性、减速抗性和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被锁闭、沉默和缴械。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。
description_en: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.

scepter.zh: 逃生技拥有%max_charges%点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。
scepter.en: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

subject: kez_switch_weapons
description_zh: 凯可以在影武长刀和翔影双钗之间变换。基于装备的武器，他会获得不同的攻击特性和技能。技能会一起升级，而且使用后，相对的武器技能也会进入冷却。凯切换到长刀后第一次长刀攻击或技能会造成额外伤害，切换到双钗后会获得额外移动速度。
description_en: Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.

scepter.zh: 在使用流派变换后%scepter_cooldown_timer%秒内施放的第一个技能不会使相对的武器技能进入冷却，或者已进入冷却的技能会结束冷却。施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。
scepter.en: Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

subject: kez_ravens_veil
description_zh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。
description_en: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

subject: largo_song_double_time
description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会提升附近友方单位的移动速度，还有短时间的减速抗性。
description_en: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.

subject: ancient_janggo
description_en: Active: Endurance  Gives +%bonus_attack_speed_pct% attack speed and +%bonus_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed to nearby allies for %duration% seconds.  Radius: %radius%     Passive: Swiftness Aura Grants %aura_movement_speed% movement speed and %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.    Radius: %radius%

subject: arcane_boots
description_en: Active: Replenish Restores %replenish_amount% mana to all nearby allies.  Radius: %replenish_radius%   Passive: Basilius Aura Grants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allies.    Radius: %aura_radius% Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Does not work on Meepo clones.

subject: boots_of_bearing
description_en: Active: Endurance  Gives +%bonus_attack_speed_pct% attack speed and +%bonus_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed to nearby allies for %duration% seconds. For the first %bonus_ms_duration% seconds allies are immune to slows.   Radius: %radius%     Passive: Swiftness Aura Grants %aura_movement_speed% movement speed and %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.    Radius: %radius% Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

subject: consecrated_wraps
description_en: Passive: Hallowed  Gain a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s, up to a maximum of %AbilityCharges% charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by %movement_speed_pct_on_stack_gain%%% for %duration%s.  Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan, consume all charges to gain an all damage barrier for %duration%s that absorbs %barrier_per_stack% damage per charge (%max_barrier_tooltip% max).
notes_en: Charges cannot be gained for %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s after you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan.
Self-damage and HP Loss damage cannot remove charges.
Movement speed buff does not stack.

subject: crellas_crozier
description_en: Active: Rite of Rumusque  You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.  Steal %movespeed_steal_pct%%% movement speed from enemy heroes in %active_radius% range every second. Movement speed steal lasts %stack_duration%s.  Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to %active_health_steal%%%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.   Passive: Putrefaction Aura Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by %health_steal%%%.  Radius: %radius%
notes_en: Ghost form ends if you become Debuff Immune and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Putrefaction Aura does not redirect Health Restoration from enemy heroes that are at full health.

subject: cyclone
description_en: Active: Cyclone  Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.  Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Cyclones cast on yourself go through spell immunity.
Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.

subject: disperser
description_en: Active: Suppress  Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for %enemy_effect_duration% seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and %slow_resist%%% slow resistance for %ally_effect_duration% seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.  Both movement speed reduction and increase start at %phase_movement_speed%%% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel    Passive: Manabreak Each attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.   Illusions do not burn mana.

subject: dust
description_en: Use: Reveal For %duration% seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by %movespeed%%% in a %radius% radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take %damage% damage.   The debuff effect on enemies lingers for %linger_duration%s after leaving the area of effect.
notes_en: Places a debuff on enemy units in the area that reveals them when they are invisible.

subject: glimmer_cape
description_en: Active: Glimmer  After a %initial_fade_delay% second delay, grants invisibility, %active_movement_speed% movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to %barrier_block% damage to you or a target allied unit for %duration% seconds.  Can be cast while channeling.

subject: guardian_greaves
description_en: Active: Mend Restores %replenish_health% health and %replenish_mana% mana to nearby allies, and removes most negative effects from the caster.  Radius: %replenish_radius% Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel    Passive: Guardian Aura  Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration and %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allied units. If the wearer's health falls below %aura_bonus_threshold%%%, their health regeneration is increased to %aura_health_regen_bonus%.   Radius: %aura_radius%  Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Mend does not affect units that have been affected by Mend or Mekansm Restore within Guardian Greaves' cooldown.

subject: invis_sword
description_en: Active: Shadow Walk Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While Shadow Walk is active, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.    If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage on that attack.
notes_en: If the invisibility ends without attacking, the bonus damage is lost.

subject: manta
description_en: Active: Mirror Image Creates %images_count% images of your hero that last %illusion_duration% seconds.   Melee images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_melee%%% damage, while Ranged images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%. Illusions take %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.   Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.
